title: Update to Oct 19 23:59 UTC — first day with the new telltales live

sections.h: Working: verified share dropped after the Oct 19 telltales went live
items: Roblox Signup (Key 2), ends-te + device-param-spoofing: ~1% verified all day Oct 19 (was 19% on Oct 18), even though volume stayed high (up to 28k/h at 13h UTC).
WBD Account Lookup (Key 20), live pagebio TT: 562k on Oct 19 at ~0% verified (23% on Oct 18).
WBD Login (Key 8): 50k burst at 11h UTC on Oct 19, 1% verified (39% on Oct 18).
Adobe ARP FF (Key 8): still 60-90% verified through the morning (85k-96k/h at 01-02h UTC), then fell to ~5% verified by 23h UTC. Something was changed late on Oct 19. Confirm it holds today.
Uber SMS (Key 1): a new burst on the live TT and grease at 14-20h UTC on Oct 19 (15-21k/h), 50-99% verified. Uber SMS needs pressure on the live TT and grease combos.
Wells Fargo Login (Key 1), di-dict3: 2-3k/h all afternoon, ~75% verified (steady since Oct 15).
Adobe Sign-in (Key 5): the grease combo jumped to 5k/h at 08-09h and 15h UTC; verified share varies from 6% to 99%.

sections.h: New signals found today (not created yet: see the highlighted table below)
items: di-dict-7 + di-short-300 + DI high-risk signature: recurring on Roblox Signup and Roblox Login since Oct 1 (93k on Oct 19, 0% verified).
sec-ch-ua/webgl RFC violation + device-param-spoofing: recurring on Uber SMS (Oct 9-11, Oct 14, Oct 16-18, mostly verified). New on Roblox Signup on Oct 19 (186k, 1% verified).
AppleOS impersonation + device-param-spoofing + sec-fetch-dest: new on Oct 18-19 on WBD Account Lookup (714k) and Olo Payments (105k), 0% verified. Already covered by the live TT, so on hold.

Not an attack: g-browser-automation-basic-render, g-browser-automation-swiftshader and g-spoofing-webgl-dimensions appeared on Oct 19 on 23-41 keys at once from a zero baseline. That looks like a new detection rollout. Check with the owners before using them.
The Uber UA-spoof combo on watch (g-spoofing-user-agent + g-di-bad-signature-list-match + g-device-parameter-spoofing) is gone on Oct 19, so it's dropped.
